parameters.content:
## Router
One Telegram Trigger for messages **and** button taps (since a bot only has one webhook). 
Normalize The Update gives every branch the same fields. 
Get Settings reads the chat's languages and level from Notion, to ensure consistency.

## /article or plain text
GNews search (5 results) → fetch all 5 pages in parallel → HTML paragraphs → keep the longest real one. No usable news page → Wikipedia in the same language. Both fail → ask for another topic. Then 2-3 themes and 15 words around the learner's level, checked in code.

## Shared save loop
Both /article and /add arrive at Words To Save with the same fields. One Notion query per word (350 ms apart) skips duplicates; new words are created with interval 1, review tomorrow.

## Button taps from the morning recall
I know it! doubles the interval, No clue! resets it to 1 day.

parameters.content:
## Settings: /lang /level /time /words
Check Setting validates the command and builds only the Notion properties that change. Existing row → PATCH, no row → create. Notion Settings columns: Chat ID (title), Source Language, Target Language, Level, Recall Hours, Daily Words (all text).

parameters.content:
## Error branch
After their retries, these nodes send failures here instead of crashing: **Get Settings**, **Find Duplicate**, **Update Interval**, **Start Review**. The user gets a tip based on what they were doing.
